changelog: ONT-WGS offline type strains: setup_typestrains.sh downloads every NCBI type-strain genome (about 22,700 genomes in 4,600 genera, ~31 GB) into the cache the pipeline already reads, so ANIb / ANIm / TETRA, the genome tree and reference mapping run without an internet connection (--genera for a subset, --status, resumable). Reference mapping: assembly-vs-reference identity is now gap-compressed (it read 83 % for a 98 % ANI isolate because long insertions counted base by base). Console: the ONT WGS form uploads whole folders (Choose folder…), leaving fastq_fail out. Backend restart required.

previous.changelog: Read quality before the run: per-position quality, lengths and a truncLen suggestion that keeps the read pairs overlapping (GET /qc, the console's Read quality panel, and a report section); optional FastQC + MultiQC. Controls in every pipeline: negative controls and mock communities (ZymoBIOMICS D6300) named in the run or in the metadata get a report section — what the blanks contain, genera at least twice as abundant in blanks as in samples, and the mock compared with its theoretical composition. MaAsLin 3 after every run with metadata: all variables at once, abundance and prevalence, optional random effects; controls are left out. Needs R >= 4.4 (update.sh installs it). Emu runs several samples at once (automatic from CPU and free memory, or set in the form); Emu env pinned to python 3.11 / pandas < 2.2. env_lock.sh export|check|restore pins conda envs, venvs and R packages. The console is now the page at / with licence, updates, workers and housekeeping under Settings, manual pairing and an orientation check; the previous UI is at /classic (NGA_DEFAULT_UI=classic or backend/ui_classic puts it back at /). Backend restart required.
